READ BY ic 2026-09-02, ON THE CANON SET AS IT STOOD AT COMMIT 1c80a627. SET COMPARED: the three root documents (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, usage-rules.md) and all 23 canon skills, against the rule library at intent/plugins/claude/rules/. THIS IS A JUDGEMENT ON THE RECORD AND NOT A MEASUREMENT -- deciding that two differently-worded paragraphs state one rule is a reading, and a later reader may weigh it differently.

VERDICT: NOT CLEAN. ONE FORK, AND IT IS THE STRONGEST FORM THE ROW ANTICIPATES -- the second home does not merely restate the rule, it MEANS SOMETHING ELSE.

THE FORK: IN-AG-PFIC-001. The rule library, which owns it, titles it "Pure Function, Impure Coordination" and its summary is an architectural rule -- keep the domain core deterministic and side-effect-free, push I/O, time, randomness and external calls to the boundary, coordinators compose pure functions and handle the effects.

SIX LIVE CANON-SET HOMES STATE IT INSTEAD AS "Pure-Functional-Idiomatic-Coordination; pattern match, pipe, tag, compose" -- a STYLE rule about functional idiom:
  1. AGENTS.md:131 (this project, generated)
  2. lib/templates/llm/_AGENTS.md:191 -- THE FLEET TEMPLATE, so every Intent project inherits it
  3. intent/plugins/claude/skills/in-standards/SKILL.md:27 -- the skill whose job is loading these four principles
  4. intent/plugins/agents/templates/_default/RULES.md:10 -- laid down at fresh init
  5. intent/llm/RULES.md:10
  6. intent/plugins/claude/rules/lua/code/dispatch-table-over-if-chain/RULE.md:177 -- INSIDE THE RULE LIBRARY ITSELF, so the library disagrees with its own agnostic pack

AND THE DRIFT HAS REACHED AN ENFORCEMENT SURFACE, WHICH IS THE COST RATHER THAN THE UNTIDINESS: in-review/SKILL.md:54 checks "pattern-match, pipe, tagged-tuple, compose idioms in play" for IN-AG-PFIC-001. A reviewer running that checklist passes code with I/O buried three calls deep in the domain core -- the exact violation the owning rule names -- and records the rule as checked.

THIS IS DIVERGENCE AT BIRTH RATHER THAN DRIFT, WHICH IS A SHARPER FINDING AND WAS CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: RULE.md has carried "Pure Function, Impure Coordination" since its creating commit 1743fa88 and has never been renamed, so the two readings were never in agreement at any point.

WHY AT-00.1's GREEN DID NOT SEE IT, AND THE REACH LIMIT THIS EXPOSES: AT-00.1 compares canon documents against rule SUMMARIES for a 12-word verbatim span. This fork shares almost no words with the summary it contradicts, and four of its six homes are skills and templates, which are not in AT-00.1's population at all. So the paraphrase half is not merely the judgement half -- it is also the half whose population is larger.

THE WORKED POSITIVES, RECORDED SO THE VERDICT IS NOT READ AS BLANKET: CLAUDE.md declines to restate the four principles and states the reason (a second copy would be a Highlander violation in the document that defines the rule), and in-essentials rule 8 declines to restate IN-AG-FIAT-001 on the same ground. Both are correct. CLAUDE.md's decline points at AGENTS.md as the stated home -- and AGENTS.md is home 1 of the fork above, so the pointer is right and its target is not.
